expected_behavior_change: Canonical bootstrap prunes persisted Admin outbox entries that are already represented by, or older than, the Cloud canonical active publish before auto-flush starts.
A stale persisted outbox can no longer overwrite the reconciled PUBLISHED status with QUEUED/PUBLISHING immediately after READY.
Only a genuinely later explicit publish remains queued.
non_goals: No Customer, Owner, SMM or SMT change.
